prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic close-up editorial portrait against a clear blue sky.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long straight platinum-blonde hair, light blue-green eyes, soft natural facial features, faint freckles, minimal makeup, and a small silver nose stud, gazing slightly upward.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered tight head-and-shoulders portrait, slightly low angle, shoulders subtly visible, cloudless blue sky background, shallow depth of field and sharp focus on eyes.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft front-facing natural sunlight with gentle chin shadow and subtle backlight around fine hair strands, calm dreamy editorial mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic DSLR-style 85mm lens, f/1.8, ISO 100, 1/500s, high-resolution 8K-style detail, warm highlights against cool sky.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic close-up editorial portrait of an approved adult woman with long straight platinum blonde hair, light blue-green eyes, soft natural facial features, minimal makeup, faint freckles, and a small silver nose stud. She gazes slightly upward with a calm dreamy introspective expression. A clear bright blue cloudless sky fills the background. Use a centered tight head-and-shoulders composition from a slightly low angle, soft natural sunlight, gentle shadows under the chin, subtle hair backlight, sharp eyes, shallow depth of field, photorealistic skin texture, 85mm lens at f/1.8, ISO 100, warm highlights and cool sky contrast.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, heavy makeup, altered face, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, logo, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

assets.name: blue-sky-platinum-blonde-girl_0.jpg

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required approved-adult reference. Preserve face, facial structure, hair, eyes, freckles, nose stud, sky, and lighting; identity may be replaced by another approved adult. No typography or logo is required.
